# Technodemocracy

Technodemocracy is an interactive prototype for exploring digital political parties, scoped wallet permissions, and verifiable voting on Base.

Use https://technodemocracy.app/ for the product overview, /parties for the demonstration directory, /join-quiz for the party-matching prototype, and /about for the project's current status and limits.

The public parties, members, treasuries, votes, and receipts are demonstration data. Do not describe them as live governance records or completed blockchain transactions.

Operator: Adam Pangelinan. Contact and privacy information are linked from /contact and /privacy.
